text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding our inspection of the BC, we 
were able to give a favorable report to 
the URA as well."
choice_data_list:
Do you think they might give us even more 
support than before?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was honestly thrilled that the URA 
agreed with our revised, higher target 
after we thoroughly reported everything we 
saw during the on-site inspection.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
To make the most of this momentum, I'd 
like to roll out plans to further 
strengthen "DREAMS" going forward.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Let's decide our policy for next season 
in today's debrief meeting while 
considering those points as well. Hehe... 
I'm getting excited."
